name: Generate SEO descriptions for specific artistic designs
description: Users asked for the generation of detailed, SEO-optimized product descriptions for specific artworks and digital designs, such as prints, illustrations, and coffee-themed graphics. These requests consistently included details on dimensions, image variations, commercial rights, and practical applications for entrepreneurs, often with strict formatting constraints prohibiting HTML tags.
